page.layout: One printed page: title block at top centre; below it a two-column brace diagram (Lectio numbers 1–10 on the left, pag. page numbers on the right); signature "Dd" at lower centre.

main_text.head: TABELLA INDICANS, quota pagina, quæque Catechismi Lectio, quę diebus Dominicis publicè in templo recitatur, inuenienda sit.

page.notes: The title is set in large spaced capitals with a hyphenated line break ("INDI-cans", "Catechi-smi", "Domini-cis", "recita-tur"); the ghosted text in the background is show-through and was not transcribed. The diagram is a brace layout: "Lectio" 1–10 paired with "pag." 7–245.
